name: Qwen releases BabelArena, a fully localized multilingual benchmark for LLM agents
title: Qwen releases BabelArena, a fully localized multilingual benchmark for LLM agents
summary: Qwen put BabelArena on Hugging Face: about 16k agent task instances across 23 languages, where prompts, tools and environments are all localized rather than only the instructions, so agent skill can be compared across languages. The accompanying paper is on Hugging Face Papers (2609.23490).
